picks.title: The Word of Soda (Pop)
picks.summary: In Episode 6, Aaron talks about the Word of Wisdom and, more specifically, our relationship with soda. From the difference between what is technically prohibited and what is actually wise to Utah’s obsession with dirty sodas, this episode explores how Latter-day Saints sometimes approach the Word of Wisdom as a list of rules rather than a principle meant to guide our choices. The question isn't simply, “Is this allowed?” Maybe it's time we also ask, “Is this wise?”
picks.reason: Explores the Word of Wisdom as a principle guiding wise choices, not just rules.
